title: NYISO CAPITL: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: NYISO via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables nyiso_dam_zone_prices, nyiso_rtm_zone_prices; data retrieved to 2026-11-05.
citations: New York Independent System Operator (NYISO). Day-Ahead Market LBMP, zonal (P-2A). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `nyiso_dam_zone_prices`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.
New York Independent System Operator (NYISO). Real-Time Market LBMP, zonal, RTD 5-minute (P-24A). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `nyiso_rtm_zone_prices`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.
facts: NYISO CAPITL, 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 18:00 local, 18.17 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 08:00, -11.98 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-04: -0.11 USD/MWh.
